rationale: With only 3 minutes to close, the last candle showed a sharp drop from ~$17.36 to $17.08 on elevated volume (293k shares), placing price well below VWAP ($17.23) and the 9-EMA ($17.33) in a deteriorating broad market (SPY -1.78%, VIXY +10%).
